topics.title: [ARFC] Governance Framework v2
topics.proposal_excerpt: This publication presents an overview of Aave DAO’s Governance Process v2 and is intended to replace the current governance process document. The framework consolidates the process into a single canonical reference and proposes a more streamlined path from forum discussion to execution.
topics.latest_comment_excerpt: The latest discussion focuses on how the updated process should handle service-provider review and whether the shorter timeline leaves enough time for technical feedback before an AIP moves forward.

topics.title: [ARFC] Aave Will Win Framework
topics.proposal_excerpt: The proposal lays out a strategic framework for Aave’s next chapter, including revenue alignment between Aave-branded products and the DAO treasury, a one-year development budget, and an accountability framework for continued execution.
topics.latest_comment_excerpt: A follow-up comment clarifies implementation details and responds to questions raised by delegates around sequencing, accountability, and the scope of the framework.
